faq.label: Operational Honesty
faq.title: FlightAgent neyi yapar, neyi vaat etmez?
faq.subtitle: FlightAgent decision intelligence ve periodic monitoring urunudur; airline operations feed degildir.

checks.a: Booked trips and tracked itineraries are checked on scheduled monitoring cycles. The dashboard shows the latest snapshot when available.

systems.q: Does FlightAgent use live airline systems?
systems.a: FlightAgent does not claim airline-grade operational access. It uses available provider data and internal monitoring records.

pricing.q: Are price signals estimated or live?
pricing.a: Fare context may be estimated or snapshot-based depending on available data. Stale or unavailable data should be labelled.

delayed.q: What happens if monitoring is delayed?
delayed.a: Delayed or stale monitoring should be shown as an operational state, not hidden behind reassuring copy.

delivery.a: Detected events and notification attempts are tracked separately. Delivery can be retried, fail, or remain pending.

mission.title: Misyonumuz
mission.content: FlightAgent, yolcularin rezervasyon oncesi itinerary kalitesini anlamasina ve booked tripleri seffaf scheduled checks ile izlemesine yardim eder. OTA degiliz; real-time airline operations vaadi vermeyiz.

story.title: Hikayemiz
story.content: FlightAgent, cheap-price sorttan fazlasina ihtiyac duyan yolcular icin kuruldu. Long-haul itineraryler tight connection, self-transfer, stale data veya kotu rebooking opsiyonlariyla risk tasir; urun karar netligi ve honest monitoring state etrafinda tasarlandi.
